title: Coordination of short-window SDNN and RMSSD: an exploratory cross-database heart-failure prediction test
abstract: Adding within-record logSDNN–logRMSSD window correlation changed external CHF-versus-normal Brier loss by -0.00348 (joint record bootstrap 95% [-0.01663, 0.00905]) beyond conventional HRV, a six-hour SDANN analogue and both marginal dispersions. The registered uncertainty criterion for incremental benefit was not met.
